title: Ask HN: Do you have any code or projects of your own you would like to talk about instead?
guide_zh: 邀请读者分享正在开发的项目与代码，让讨论回到技术实践。
author: raganwald
excerpt: Tired of other discussions dominating the front page? Tell us what you're working on right now, and please include a link to actual code. Let's get back in touch with hacking!

title: Ask PG: Cost and effort of running Hacker News?
guide_zh: 运营 HN 每月需要多少硬件费用，又要投入多少维护和管理时间？
author: knightinblue
excerpt: In terms of servers and hardware , how much does it cost to keep hacker news up and running each month? In terms of man hours, how much is needed to maintain and moderate hacker news?

title: Ask HN: Any programmers here that are able to make a living selling their own programs?
guide_zh: 有没有靠销售自制软件谋生的程序员，邀请分享产品与经营经验。
author: doubleyooexwhy
excerpt: If so, feel free to share any advice you might have, and plug your own product as well. I'm a programmer always looking for inspiration, and my dream is to make a living writing and selling my /own/ software, from my /own/ computer chair.

title: (More Explicit) Advice to Summer Applicants
guide_zh: YC 提醒申请者，遇到限时投资条款时可以申请提前面试。
author: pg
excerpt: The exploding termsheets http://ycombinator.com/exploding.html have started to arrive. I just talked to a group who got one, and they hadn't realized we were willing to interview groups early when this happened. So I should be more explicit: If you get an exploding offer, send us an email, and if we were going to interview you, we'll do it early.

title: Tell HN: I didn't get a job due to a failed startup on my resume
guide_zh: 作者称失败创业经历反而妨碍求职，分享一次令人失望的招聘结果。
author: zubar
excerpt: My startup went down the pan due to lack of money (what's new?) I was always told the expereince you get from a failed startup is a good thing. Well, a certain large software company doesn't seem to think so. Apparently, "as an entrepeneur you are obviously a free spirit, not the kind of person that settles well in a normal job, we would never hire people with a failed startup on their resume". Thanks HN. You lied to me about the true cost of a failed startup.

title: Ask: Who is Tara Ploughman?
guide_zh: 网上到处引用 Tara Ploughman，但她究竟是谁、有什么背景？
author: Raplh
excerpt: Google shows her quotes ALL over the web. But it does not (within my googling ability anyway) give a hint who or where she actually is. Since PG has her quotes on his website, I hoped it would be alright to ask here.
